title: Initial support for Linux mac80211_hwsim Netlink dissection
description:
Based on nl80211 dissector code. Tested with simple create, query, delete workflow.

More things to implement here such as embedded 802.11 frame dissection (similar to nl80211 dissector) but need to start somewhere!
